# ANGEL GUILD SURPASSES 3 MILLION PAYING MEMBERS, DOUBLING IN JUST OVER ONE YEAR


Membership and recurring revenue have doubled since August 2025


Provo, UT—September 14, 2026


Angel (NYSE: ANGX), a media and technology company pioneering an audience-driven studio model, today announced that the **Angel Guild has surpassed 3 million paying members** — doubling from 1.5 million members on August 23, 2025.


In addition to paying recurring membership fees to support stories that match their values, Guild members screen films and television series before release and vote on which projects Angel distributes in theaters and on the Angel platform.


"Three million Guild members, double where we stood just over a year ago, is an important early milestone," said Neal Harmon, co-founder and CEO of Angel. "Growth like this tells us audiences want something different. They want great entertainment, they want a voice in what gets made, and they want Angel's tech and marketing engine to spread the stories they choose to audiences everywhere. Together, Guild members now direct over half a billion dollars a year toward stories that match their values. And we’re just warming up."


Angel continues to expand its slate of original and theatrical entertainment for the Guild. The company is bringing back Guild-favorite original series, including new seasons of *The Wingfeather Saga, Homestead* and *Testament* .


Angel's theatrical slate continues with *Runner* , an action thriller starring Owen Wilson and Alan Ritchson. Upcoming theatrical releases include *Angel and the Badman* , *Drummer Boy* , *Hershey* and *Zero A.D.*


The 3 million-member milestone represents another step in Angel’s strategy to build a global entertainment platform in which audiences participate directly in determining which stories reach the screen.


###


**About Angel**


Angel (NYSE: ANGX) is a media and technology company successfully pioneering a first-of-its-kind audience-driven studio model. Founded by brothers who struggled to find films they could watch with their children, Angel was built on the belief that there was a global audience hungry for values-driven storytelling that amplifies light, celebrates hope, and inspires the moral imagination of viewers. That audience became the Angel Guild, a rapidly growing community of 3 million paying members who watch, screen, and vote on which films and television series get produced and distributed in theaters and on the Angel app. According to Rotten Tomatoes, Angel’s releases average among the highest audience satisfaction scores in the industry* It has done so while evolving a new economic model that shares profits more fully with filmmakers. For more information, visit[www.angel.com](https://www.angel.com/) .
